reactions: [Hacker News] > You get more done without realising you're learning less Unfortunately, I think many folks now just don't place any value on learning or knowing things because they can "just ask AI". That's probably my biggest fear with AI is that people just don't see any value to knowing things anymore. And quite ironically, AI is amazing for learning new things.

[Hacker News] I think the bigger issue is skipping the process through which you learn. Personally I learn the most when I am stuck on something for hours trying to figure it out and I miss all of that when AI gives a solution right away. You get more done without realising you're learning less.

[Hacker News] I always compare it to satnav: how many people bother checking maps and figuring out the route to go anywhere nowadays, just punch it into your satnav and hit "Go!".
